handover_protocol.new_chat_start: Read CURRENT first, then fresh-reconcile live GitHub main, open PRs, branches and CI before acting. Live GitHub outranks this snapshot.

lane.name: Culinary App / Culinary Lab — Corpus Scale / 100k Readiness with additive YouTube Culinary Discovery child programme
lane.rule: Do not perform ordinary Culinary Brain / Knowledge Core implementation from this lane.
lane.knowledge_core_boundary: Knowledge Core remains read-only/reconciliation from this lane and must never become a private browser/runtime dependency.
lane.nutrition_boundary: Nutrition remains an independent resumable lane and must not be overwritten or weakened by corpus-scale or YouTube-discovery work.

operating_contract.autonomy: Proceed autonomously through technically resolvable repository work after fresh reconciliation and after any explicit human-only dependency is satisfied.
operating_contract.user_facing_rule: No routine narration. Speak only for a genuine human/security/cost/policy gate, unrecoverable error, terminal material result, or continuation boundary.
operating_contract.fresh_reconciliation: Before every meaningful write or merge, fresh-reconcile main, open PRs, relevant branches, changed files, CI and concurrent work.
operating_contract.actions_authority: Normal repository CI, browser acceptance, roadmap-required benchmark workflows, path-scoped validation and technically necessary ordinary reruns are standing-preauthorized by AGENTS.md. Do not reintroduce per-run approval gates.
operating_contract.cost_boundary: No paid Cloudflare plan, paid API, paid corpus licence or other new recurring infrastructure cost is authorized. A materially abnormal CI loop or runaway Actions consumption is a cost gate; ordinary expected CI is not.
operating_contract.continuation_rule: At a continuation boundary rotate PREVIOUS/CURRENT in GitHub and keep CURRENT sufficient for a new chat to resume without copy-paste.

Do not upload these packaged bodies to R2 unless that chain is repaired or independently derive a bounded pilot from verified public-domain source representations with our own provenance.

youtube_culinary_discovery.purpose: Use a distinct YouTube Data API client as a transient high-throughput culinary discovery/navigation layer feeding independently reviewed World Recipe Atlas and app corpus candidates; never treat raw YouTube results as permanent recipes.
youtube_culinary_discovery.separation: Distinct API client/use case from youtube-blue-lagoon-lab; no credential, quota, planner-state or evidence sharing.
youtube_culinary_discovery.expected_current_search_quota: 100 search.list calls/day only after the Cloud Console confirms the assigned Search Queries limit; preserve >=5-call reserve and target <=95 planned calls/day by default.
youtube_culinary_discovery.secret_rule: Never commit or paste the key into repository files or handovers.
youtube_culinary_discovery.storage_rule: Raw YouTube API metadata is transient only and must not enter immutable Git history; default <=7-day cache and never exceed the current policy refresh/delete horizon.
youtube_culinary_discovery.policy_rule: Do not assume durable derived culinary classifications/metrics from YouTube API Data are permitted. Recheck current YouTube Developer Policies and derived-metrics rules before live scale or automated long-lived classification; use audit/permission path when required.
youtube_culinary_discovery.next_executable_action: Implement YT-CUL-0 schemas, quota ledger, planner, synthetic fixtures, transient-cache/TTL contract and daily funnel report with zero live API calls.
youtube_culinary_discovery.live_resume_when: Owner has created the distinct Google Cloud project, enabled YouTube Data API v3, verified assigned quota and stored a restricted API key as repository/runner secret CULINARY_YOUTUBE_API_KEY; current policy review remains green.

human_gate.reason: The accepted Step 7 production pilot requires real Cloudflare account resources and owner-controlled Access membership configuration. No connected Cloudflare management capability is available in this session, and credentials/secrets must not be committed to GitHub.
owner_actions: Create or connect a Cloudflare Pages project to DataRaul/culinary-recommender-app.
Create one Cloudflare R2 Standard bucket for the pilot corpus.
Enable Cloudflare Zero Trust / Access on the protected production hostname.
Enable One-time PIN as the login method.
Create an Access allow policy containing only exact invited email addresses; the owner address alone is sufficient for initial validation.
Do not add Everyone, wildcard/broad email-domain, or OTP-only Include rules.
Do not enable a paid Workers, Access or R2 plan and do not create D1.
Do not commit email addresses, account IDs, API tokens, secrets or credentials to the repository.
safe_information_to_return_after_setup: Confirm that the Pages project exists.
Confirm that the R2 bucket exists.
Confirm that Access protects the intended hostname and uses exact-email allowlisting plus OTP.
Non-secret project/hostname/bucket names may be provided if useful; never paste API tokens or secrets into the repository.

owner_actions: Using the existing Google account is sufficient; no second YouTube account is needed for the V0 public-data client.
Create a distinct Google Cloud project for the Culinary API client, recommended display name culinary-youtube-discovery.
Enable YouTube Data API v3 for that project.
Create an API key for public read-only discovery; OAuth is not required for V0 public Search/list reads.
Restrict the key at least to YouTube Data API v3 and keep it in the repository/runner secret store as CULINARY_YOUTUBE_API_KEY.
Verify the project's actual Search Queries daily limit in APIs & Services -> YouTube Data API v3 -> Quotas & System Limits; do not assume an unverified limit.
Do not create additional Culinary projects for the same client/use case merely to multiply quota.
Do not paste the API key into chat, issues, commits or handovers.

corpus_scale.name: STEP_7_PRODUCTION_SHAPED_REAL_SOURCE_PILOT
corpus_scale.resume_when: Cloudflare Pages, R2 and Access resources exist under the exact-email invitation-only contract.

youtube_culinary_discovery.name: YT_CUL_0_ARCHITECTURE_POLICY_SYNTHETIC_IMPLEMENTATION
instructions: Implement only isolated additive acquisition/control-plane code and synthetic fixtures; do not change public runtime behavior.
Implement a hard quota ledger with project/client identity, current-limit configuration, >=5-call reserve and no cross-use with Blue Lagoon.
Implement transient raw-data TTL/cleanup semantics; raw YouTube API metadata must never be committed to Git history.
Implement the daily conversion-funnel report: calls -> transient candidates -> independently reviewed sources -> Atlas promotions -> app handoffs -> actual public admissions.
Do not create creator/channel quality scores or infer authenticity/popularity from YouTube engagement metrics.
Stop before live API calls until CULINARY_YOUTUBE_API_KEY exists and current policy/project quota is revalidated.

terminal_instruction_for_new_chat: Open docs/handovers/CURRENT.json first and fresh-reconcile live GitHub. Preserve Corpus Scale Steps 1–6 and the Step 7 Cloudflare gate. The additive YouTube Culinary Discovery programme is separately READY at YT-CUL-0 with zero live quota; continue that architecture/synthetic lane if desired, but do not make live YouTube calls until the distinct Culinary Google Cloud project, verified quota and CULINARY_YOUTUBE_API_KEY secret exist and current policy review passes.
